text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Yes, Father. Leave the next presentation to me.
I'll prepare the materials as well.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Satono Crown was entrusted with an important task by her father.
However...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"Phew... We can scout the venue tomorrow, but
I'd really like to gather a bit more research data.
In that case, if I cut back on my self-study time..."
choice_data_list: Is there anything I can help with too?
Is there anything I can do to help?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Thank you.
But I'm alright, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
I'm doing it within a range that doesn't interfere with training.
...Besides, it's a job that was entrusted to me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Still, fatigue is visible around her eyes.
I want to at least help her unwind, but...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Don't make such a worried face.
I'll manage my schedule properly, too...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Huh? My notebook...
Ah, could it have been during yesterday's meeting—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
—Found it!
Looks like it slipped under the rack.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
“Still, we really made a mess searching everywhere.
Dust is flying everywhere, too...”

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, Trainer.
I'll clean up to make it up to you.
choice_data_list: No, no, don't worry about it—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Then, a thought strikes me.
Perhaps this might be an opportunity.
choice_data_list: Well then, shall we clean up together?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Oh, are you sure?
Then... let's do that!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Should the magazines go on this shelf?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: OK! I'll sort them by genre.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Sports science magazines go in back-issue order, right? And race history books by publisher...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
There's dust built up between the keyboard keys.
I'm going to borrow that canned air over there.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Hmm hum hum~♪
Fly away, fly away, little dust~♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Hao! Getting the dust out of hard-to-clean spots like this feels so refreshing~♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Cleaning is said to increase the secretion of happiness hormones
and relieve stress.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Cleaning her room seems to be
a great way for Satono Crown to refresh her mind!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And with that, the room was
mostly cleaned up, but...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Oh? Doesn't look like you've made
much progress organizing the record files.
choice_data_list: Yeah, there were more files than I expected.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: I see...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
In that case, I'll take over that task!
I'm almost done with my cleaning section anyway.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: "Isn't it more rational to give work to someone with time to spare?"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Carrying it all on your own is...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Thank you.
But I'm alright, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
I'm doing it within a range that doesn't interfere with training.
...Besides, it's a job that was entrusted to me.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"...Trainer. Let's do it together.
It'll go faster with two of us. Besides―"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: I want to help you, too.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"Just as you're always
looking out for me."
choice_data_list: I see. In that case, please do.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Yes, leave it to me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward...
As thanks for cleaning up, I took Satono Crown
to a nearby cafe.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Phew... Relaxing like this really makes me realize it.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"...Looks like I got a bit too eager.
Being trusted with an important job made me feel like I had to do my best."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Thanks to you, I finally realized it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While trying to make sure she didn't overwork herself,
it never crossed my mind to just do my share
of the cleaning together with her.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
You're right. Looking at each other, noticing things,
and supporting one another...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"I'll be watching you even more closely than before.
So you'd better watch me too—"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Will you keep watching over me?
Even though I can be stubborn at times.
choice_data_list: In that case, let's take this opportunity to review our tasks.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Will you keep watching over me?
Even though I can be stubborn at times.
choice_data_list: In that case, let's take this opportunity to review our tasks.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. This makes it a win-win.
I'm counting on you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"Getting right to work—as expected of my Trainer.
I'm looking forward to your stellar advice."
